text:
marie-docs: opening PR to tighten SOC2-friendly phrasing around audit export retention + add lightweight SDK migration tips. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102

own-eng: thanks. can we be explicit about three behaviors for exports: user-set retention_seconds, operator archival lifecycle, and legal hold/administrative suspension? engineers kept asking which field actually prevents cleanup.

lena-legal: suggested wording: "Legal holds suspend automated deletion and require documented disposition before permanent removal." avoids implying immediate deletion on request.

marie-docs: added that exact sentence under "Retention & legal holds". Also put a tiny table mapping API field -> operator effect to reduce ambiguity.

samir-eng: add a short runtime note: the cleanup cron skips export records with metadata.hold==true; when hold is cleared deletion resumes from that point.

marie-docs: added. Also included curl/node/python snippets showing create-export with retention_seconds and redact_pii, plus an example export status JSON clients should handle:

{"export_id":"exp_xyz789","status":"held","legal_hold":true,"retention_seconds":0}

own-eng: LGTM for examples. migration note: clients should treat unknown status values as "pending review" rather than failing.

lena-legal: run SOC2 wording linter and tag @legal-review before merging.

marie-docs: running linter now and will tag legal in PR description. changelog entry added: "Clarify retention semantics; document legal hold behavior; add SDK migration samples."

deploy-bot: CI passed for docs site build.

marie-docs: thanks all — merging after legal signoff. Will follow up to backport snippets into SDK READMEs.
